profile.name: NODAYSIDLE
profile.title: Independent Software Engineer & Systems Builder
profile.tagline: Turning ambiguous problems into real products and working systems.

statement.headline: A craft-driven engineering practice rooted in native performance and local-first architecture.
statement.atelier: I design, architect, and ship production-grade software across macOS native environments, high-performance desktop runtimes, and resilient web services. I avoid disposable prototypes and roadmap hype: every project in the catalogue has one clear job, a reproducible build, and working code that runs directly on hardware.
statement.craft: My work focuses on transforming unstructured, ambiguous goals into deterministic software. From low-latency audio processing and on-device Core ML to custom desktop tools and spec-driven code synthesis, I build with high agency, deep respect for platform conventions, and strict privacy by default.
statement.metricsSummary: 70+ repositories • 10+ native macOS apps • Local-first SQLite & zero unexpected telemetry.

principles.title: Ship Real Products
principles.summary: Finished tools over slide decks. If an application exists in the catalogue, it compiles cleanly, passes tests, and installs without a debug session.

principles.title: Native First
principles.summary: Build for the platform, not against it. Swift 6, AppKit, Metal, and Rust over heavy wrappers to guarantee instant responsiveness and zero memory bloat.

principles.title: Local-First by Default
principles.summary: User data lives on-device in local SQLite or filesystem storage. Cloud integrations are explicit opt-in enhancements, never architectural lock-in.

principles.title: Deterministic Quality
principles.summary: Spec-driven architectures, strict typing, and end-to-end automated validation ensure systems behave predictably across every execution.

featuredProjects.name: FlowState
featuredProjects.tagline: Adaptive focus detection & deep work pacing for macOS
featuredProjects.description: Native macOS menu-bar utility that calculates real-time focus depth through hardware input telemetry (IOKit HID) and applies gentle screen-tint nudges when flow is broken. Zero arbitrary timers, zero cloud dependencies.

featuredProjects.name: Orbit Browser
featuredProjects.tagline: Minimal chrome, full web. Native macOS browser
featuredProjects.description: Distraction-free desktop browser built on Tauri v2, Rust, and WKWebView. Features native tab management, distraction-free reader mode, built-in tracker stripping, and local SQLite session persistence without Chrome's footprint.
highlights: Native WKWebView tabs with drag reorder

featuredProjects.name: CloudScribe
featuredProjects.tagline: Sub-second floating dictation pill for macOS
featuredProjects.description: Low-latency global dictation utility streaming to Deepgram nova-3 with instant keyboard injection. Features a minimal floating HUD, global hotkey listener, and encrypted credential storage backed by the macOS Keychain.

featuredProjects.name: ShareGuard
featuredProjects.tagline: Pre-share privacy scanner & local redaction engine
featuredProjects.description: Local-first security scanner for pre-commit and pre-upload inspection. Scans files, folders, and clipboard buffers for leaked API keys, tokens, and PII before they leave your machine. Runs fully offline.

featuredProjects.name: EchoCore Pro
featuredProjects.tagline: Local voice intelligence & neural speech engine
featuredProjects.description: High-throughput on-device speech synthesis and voice cloning engine optimized for Apple Silicon Metal acceleration. Pairs WhisperKit transcription with local Kokoro and Qwen3 neural weights.

featuredProjects.name: Ironclad / NDI Compiler
featuredProjects.description: Multi-tier code compilation platform that ingests ambiguous natural language goals and generates strict, auditable 5-document technical specifications (PRD, ARD, TRD, TASKS, AGENT) with reproducible code output.
